paper_title: The Complexity of Verifying Loop-Free Programs as Differentially Private
statement: Approximating the differential privacy parameters We show that distinguishing (ε, δ)-differential privacy from (ε0 , δ 0 ) differential privacy where (ε, δ) < (ε0 , δ 0 ) is both NP- and coNP-hard. We leave refining the classification of this problem as an open problem.
context: Solvers mixing non-determinism and counting Returning to our motivation for this work – developing practical tools for verifying differential privacy – our results seem to point to a deficiency in available tools for model checking. The model checking toolkit includes well established Sat solvers for NP (and coNP) problems, solvers for further quantification in PH, solvers for #Sat (and hence for #P problems3 ).
